scripts.features:
# 🍄 MARIO HUB — FEATURES

**15 Supported Games | Free Script Hub**

Powerful automation, smart farming, combat tools, ESP, teleportation, and quality-of-life features across multiple Roblox games.

---

### 🐜 Build An Ant Empire
- **Smart Kaitun** — Fully automated food farming, selling, ant rolling, and progression.
- **Auto Food Farm** — Collect worker ant food, carry resources, and sell with minimum-price control.
- **Ant Automation** — Auto roll, rarity-based claiming, and equip best ants.
- **Smart Upgrades** — Automatically upgrade pools and stats with cash reserves and custom priorities.
- **Auto Rewards & Travel** — Claim online rewards, travel between destinations, and return to saved positions.
- **Player Utilities** — Walk Speed, Fly, Noclip, Fullbright, and ESP.
- **Extra** — Stop All, MarioBanner, English/Thai UI, and saved configurations.

### 💣 +1 TNT Mining
- **Smart Auto Mine** — Target valuable mining spots and automatically collect drops.
- **Remote Collect & Sell** — Collect and sell resources from anywhere.
- **Fast Auto Click** — Maximum game-supported clicking speed.
- **Auto Progression** — Rebirth, best bomb, upgrades, new areas, and mine luck.
- **Pet Automation** — Auto hatch, equip best, and sell extras with rarity protection.
- **Extra** — Secret Block Alerts, Auto Rewards, FPS Boost, and Auto Rejoin.
- **All-in-One Kaitun** — Fully automated mining and progression.

### ⚒️ Loot To Forge
- **Max Gear** — Automatically optimize weapons, armor, hats, runes, and enhancements.
- **Unlimited Auto Forge** — Forge using selected ores continuously.
- **Auto Complete Index** — Find missing equipment and display forge probabilities.
- **Item Spawner** — Spawn ores, enchant runes, weapons, armor, hats, and other resources.
- **Inventory Duplication** — Duplicate inventory stacks with one click.
- **Currency & Resources** — Add Season Coins, Race Rolls, Season Tickets, and Tokens.
- **Auto Token Shop** — Obtain available passes and packs without spending tokens.
- **Unlimited Potions** — Power and Damage potions with long-lasting buffs.
- **Combat Tools** — Kill Aura, Auto Ore Boss, Invincibility, and Keep Ore on Death.
- **Auto Tower Farm** — Farm rare stones and Season Coins using a single ticket.
- **Auto Season** — Daily tickets, spins, season pass rewards, and shop automation.
- **Auto Race Roll** — Roll for selected races and automatically refill rolls.
- **Auto World Boss** — Join boss fights, defeat bosses, and claim reward cards.
- **Smart Boss Server Hop** — Find active bosses, wait for spawns, and collect rewards.
- **Pet Automation** — Auto incubate, hatch, refill slots, target rare pets, and manage surplus eggs.
- **Auto Progression** — Sell, equip, train, click, rebirth, upgrade, and optimize race slots.
- **Extra** — Item Previews, Low-Population Server Hop, Save/Return Position.
- **All-in-One Kaitun** — Fully automated farming and progression.

### 🌊 Open Sea For Animals
- **Auto Loot** — Collect valuable eggs and Brainrots from incoming waves without leaving your base.
- **Unlimited Carry** — Collect an entire wave at once. *(Risky)*
- **Smart Loot Filters** — Customize collection by rarity and mutation.
- **Auto Sell** — Automatically sell eggs and Brainrots with protected-item filters.
- **Auto Hatch & Place** — Hatch eggs and place the best animals.
- **Auto Progression** — Upgrades, training, best dumbbell, and rebirth.
- **Auto Extras** — Pickaxe, potions, wheel spins, season rewards, and even
